ai_summary: Bharti Airtel Limited received two separate notices from the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) for alleged violations of subscriber verification norms in Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, incurring penalties totaling Rs. 891,000. While the company has opted to pay the Rs. 675,000 penalty for Andhra Pradesh, it intends to contest the Rs. 216,000 penalty for Madhya Pradesh. Although the immediate financial impact is immaterial, the recurrence of such issues across different regions highlights a potential underlying weakness in customer verification compliance processes.
